999008199.text:
「光星隊」……あの隊は、そう名付けられたんだね。
うん、希望を感じさせるいい名前だ！

localizations.en: The Star Vanguard... so that's what you named it. I love it—full of hope and light!

999008199.text:
でしょ？　私が名付けたんだ。
そして……隊長は私！　立候補して選ばれたの！

localizations.en: Right? I came up with it myself. And I'm the captain! I threw my name in the ring and got chosen!

999008199.text:
頂獣や極夜の錬金党のような脅威に対抗するための
特殊部隊として、これから頑張っていくよ！

localizations.en: We're a special unit built to counter threats like the Apexi and the Polar Night Alchemists. We'll do great things!

999008199.text:
隊員はみんな、私が見定めた精鋭揃いだからね！
といっても初陣はまだ先だから、当分は訓練漬けかな

localizations.en: And every last member is an elite I hand-picked myself! Though our first real mission is still a ways off, so it's pretty much all training for now.

999008199.text:
クレオはウェルテックスが来た時、刺激された魔物を
南部の辺境で完全に抑え込んだ――

localizations.en: When Weltex appeared, you single-handedly contained the monsters it stirred up along the southern frontier—

999008199.text:
その定評もあって、特殊部隊の指揮官か。
さすがじゃないか！　おめでとう！

localizations.en: —and now you're commanding a special unit on the strength of that reputation. I'd say that's well deserved! Congratulations!

999008199.text:
へへん、それほどでも……あるけど？
もっとほめてほめて！

localizations.en: Hehe, I mean, it's not that big a deal... actually it totally is. Tell me more!

999008199.text: よっ！　闘う王女様！　自慢の妹！

localizations.en: Hear, hear! The fighting princess herself! My pride and joy of a little sister!

999008199.text:
私はこれからより責任のある立場になる。
部下だけじゃない、国民みんなの命が懸かってるんだ

localizations.en: I'm stepping into a position of real responsibility now. It's not just my soldiers' lives on the line—it's the people of the whole kingdom.

999008199.text:
そんな期待と責任を背負えるだけの力はある……
私自身、そう思ってる

localizations.en: But I have what it takes to carry that weight. I genuinely believe that.

999008199.text:
白夜の騎士、ユナにはかなわないかもだけど……
ううん、ユナにだって、いつか勝ってみせるよ

localizations.en: I might not be a match for Juna of the Midnight Sun yet... but someday, I'll beat her too.

999008199.text:
うん、その意気だ。クレオみたいな勇気ある者が
隊長なら、光星隊はきっといい隊になるよ

localizations.en: That's the spirit. With someone as brave as you leading the charge, the Star Vanguard is going to be something special.

999008199.text:
うん！　私についてきてくれる部下たちのためにも、
隊長として精一杯頑張るよ！

localizations.en: Yeah! I'll give everything I have as their captain—for the sake of every one of them who chose to follow me!

999008199.text:
みんな、討伐訓練お疲れさま！　いい連携だったよ！
王女より「素晴らしい成果で賞」を授与します！

localizations.en: Great work today, everyone! Excellent teamwork out there! By royal decree, you are hereby awarded the Spectacular Performance Prize!

999008199.text:
光栄です！　でも上手くいったのは
隊長の的確な指示があってこそですよ！

localizations.en: The honor is ours! But we only pulled it off because of your sharp commands, Captain!

999008199.text:
隊としても、俺自身も、成長を感じています。
隊長のご指導ご鞭撻のおかげです！

localizations.en: I can feel us growing—as a unit and as individuals. That's all thanks to your guidance, Captain.

999008199.text:
私もみんなの隊長として鼻が高いよ～！
みんな、私についてきてくれてありがとう

localizations.en: You're all making me so proud~! Thank you for sticking by me, everyone.

999008199.text:
さぁ、光星隊！　この調子で訓練を重ねて、
初陣を華々しく飾ってあげましょーっ！

localizations.en: Alright, Star Vanguard! Let's keep up this momentum and make our first mission one to remember!

999008199.text:
なんだ、この強さ……！
これまでの魔物の、比じゃない……！

localizations.en: What... what kind of power is this...?! Nothing like any monster we've faced before...!

999008199.text:
俺たちの連携が通じない……！
すべて、見抜かれてるみたいだ……

localizations.en: Our formations aren't working...! It's like they can see right through every move we make...!

999008199.text:
１班！　２班！　みんな！
そ、そんな……

localizations.en: First squad! Second squad! Everyone! This can't be...

999008199.text: あなたたち……いったい、何者……？

localizations.en: Just who... who are you people...?

999008199.text: 俺か？　名乗る謂れはないが

localizations.en: Me? No reason to introduce myself.

999008199.text:
私はクレオ・ランターナ。
ランターナ王女にして、光星隊の隊長よ！

localizations.en: I'm Creo Lantarna. Princess of Lantarna and Captain of the Star Vanguard!

999008199.text:
ほう。俺はヘルト。九偉人の長兄にして、
この世界の英雄だ。こっちはゼロ

localizations.en: Hm. I'm Held—eldest of the Miraculous Nine, hero of this world. And this is Zero.

999008199.text:
今の世界を見て回るついでに「王国の精鋭部隊」が
いると聞いたんで寄ってみたんじゃが……

localizations.en: We heard there was some 'elite royal unit' worth seeing while we were making the rounds. So here we are, and...

999008199.text:
この程度で精鋭とは。俺たちが寝ている間も
人類はまったく進歩していなかったらしい

localizations.en: This is what passes for elite. Seems humanity made no progress at all while we were sleeping.

999008199.text:
ヘルト……ゼロ……！
よくも……よくも私の大切な部下たちを……！

localizations.en: Held... Zero...! How dare you... how dare you do this to my soldiers...!

999008199.text:
言っておくが、誰一人殺してないぞ。
力を量るためだけの遊びだからな

localizations.en: To be clear, no one's dead. It was just a bit of sport—measuring your strength.

999008199.text:
とはいえ、何人かは深手じゃ。
さっさと手当てしてやるんじゃな

localizations.en: That said, some of them took quite a beating. You'd best see to them quickly.

999008199.text:
ではな、「こうえいたい」とやら。
二度と会うことはないだろう

localizations.en: Farewell then, 'Starvangard,' or whatever it was.

999008199.text: 「こうえいたい」じゃない……！

「光星隊」だ……！　これから、華々しく……！！
ランターナの平和を守る……特殊部隊だ……！！！

localizations.en: It's the Star Vanguard...! And we were going to shine...!! Guardians of Lantarna's peace...!!!

999008199.text:
ヘルトにゼロ……覚えた……！！
部下たちの借りは、私が必ず……！！！

localizations.en: Held... Zero... I won't forget this...!! I'll pay back every debt my soldiers are owed... I swear it!!!
